dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: The monsters have disappeared, but still, a fissure remains. And through it...

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: I sense the thick stench of the Abyss. Something lurks behind this rift.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Well, come out then. Or would you prefer a sealed letter of invitation?

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Did you truly think sneaking out of the fissure unseen would allow you to escape our eyes?

dialogues.speaker: Strange Rift
dialogues.text: (Though the monsters have dispersed, the darkness has not faded. You may need to enlist the help of a professional who knows more about the Wild Hunt.)

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: The monsters that follow the Wild Hunt do not utterly lack intelligence, and they have some sense of strategy.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: As such, the consequences for underestimating the enemy in any battle are dire indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: The monsters here have been driven back, and yet a Wild Hunt rift remains. Could it be...?

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Enough hiding, you wretch. I know you're lurking behind that rift.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Cheap tricks like this won't fool me. Come out and face your end!

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: That should be the last of them... The old man was right. The Wild Hunt has been getting craftier lately.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Looks like we'll need to be a lot more careful from now on.
